title: No drain while off
line: Lets the fingerprint reader power down, so the battery doesn't drain while the Ally is off.
symptom: The fingerprint reader (1c7a:0588) stays powered and drains the battery even with the Ally switched off.
why: The fingerprint reader 1c7a:0588 (Ally, Ally X). The Xbox Allys also have a power-button reader; its USB id isn't confirmed, so the fix is offered there and checks for the part.
risk_note: One udev rule, the same one Bazzite ships.

changes.detail: Lets the fingerprint reader (USB 1c7a:0588) power down by itself.
Set to auto at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.
steamos: Reported fixed in SteamOS 3.8 and later (second-hand, from a write-up of the 3.8.0 notes; not yet confirmed on our Ally). The fix checks the system's own rules.

probe.what: Looks for the same rule from the system itself (any udev rule that isn't GameCove's and does the same), or the value already being right without GameCove.

watch.note: SteamOS release notes: 3.8 is reported to fix this; once confirmed on an Ally, add a SteamOS version rule.
